description: Falcon Field Airport Jobs and Businesses is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. Temporary dataset of the number of jobs and businesses within the Falcon Field business area by month. Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. The portal files it under the category Falcon Field Airport. The table has 3 columns. The portal shows 2025-02-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
